identity.name: Legacy Machine X
identity.one_liner: A 10th-anniversary Legacy Machine, built on the original LM1 architecture with a central flying balance wheel and two independent time displays angled toward the wearer.

narrative.story: MB&F released LMX in 2021 to mark ten years since the original Legacy Machine 1 introduced the brand's now-recognizable format of dual time displays flanking a central flying balance wheel. LMX pairs that layout with a seven-day power reserve, positioning it as both an anniversary piece and the longest-running Legacy Machine in terms of autonomy.
narrative.collector_notes: The titanium and red-gold versions were priced and released together rather than gold coming first as a limited run; collectors treat material as a wearing preference more than a scarcity signal for this specific reference.
